verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is built on multi-party protocols rather than a private integration. It implements both the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) checkout flows. Its docs name several independent platforms it works with: AI agents such as Gemini, ChatGPT and Copilot, catalog sync to OpenAI and Meta, and a dedicated Google agentic commerce integration. Missing for 10: independent or third-party corroboration that these parties actually implement or interoperate in production (all evidence is vendor-claimed), and no evidence of other payment providers implementing the same protocols alongside Adyen.
